items.stem: An operations team wants one query surface across logs from 30 services in different regions. What is the recommended baseline?

options.text: Route diagnostic settings from each service to a single centralised Log Analytics workspace
options.rationale: Correct: a central workspace enables cross-service KQL and correlation.

options.text: Download logs from each service portal manually each morning
options.rationale: Manual export does not scale and loses queryability.

options.text: Enable metrics only and disable log collection
options.rationale: Metrics alone cannot answer root-cause questions.

options.text: Create one workspace per service and never join them

items.explanation: Correct: a central workspace enables cross-service KQL and correlation.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO practices support least-privilege administration in Azure? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Assign the narrowest built-in or custom role scoped to the smallest resource group
options.rationale: Correct: scope and role granularity limit blast radius.

options.text: Use Microsoft Entra PIM to make privileged roles eligible and time-bound
options.rationale: Correct: just-in-time elevation reduces standing privilege.

options.text: Grant every engineer Owner on the subscription for convenience
options.rationale: Standing Owner access is excessive and risky.

options.text: Share one administrator account among the team

items.explanation: Correct: scope and role granularity limit blast radius.

items.stem: A storefront's CPU spikes during flash sales and users see timeouts. Which action group plus scaling response is most appropriate?

options.text: A metric alert on sustained CPU with an autoscale rule adding instances
options.rationale: Correct: autoscale on a sustained signal absorbs load; the alert notifies on-call.

options.text: A single email alert with no scaling configured
options.rationale: Notification without scaling does not resolve the overload.

options.text: Manually add VMs after each incident
options.rationale: Manual response is too slow for flash traffic.

items.explanation: Correct: autoscale on a sustained signal absorbs load; the alert notifies on-call.
